# TaskPilot

> **TaskPilot** is an AI-native, self-hosted project management platform for tasks, projects, sprints, and team collaboration. It is **not** Linear, Jira, Asana, or any other third-party service — TaskPilot is its own independent system. This file is the single point of integration reference for both the **REST API** and the **MCP/A2A** servers.

This document is written for LLMs and integrators. Everything needed to programmatically read or modify TaskPilot data is here.

---

## Deployment URLs (this instance)

| Surface | URL | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Web app | `https://taskpilot.sudiptadhara.in` | End-user UI |
| REST API | `https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in` | HTTP/JSON API (programmatic) |
| MCP / A2A server | `https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in` | MCP protocol + A2A protocol for AI agents |
| Live (collab/realtime) | `https://taskpilot-live.sudiptadhara.in` | WebSocket / live collaboration |
| Admin | `https://taskpilot-admin.sudiptadhara.in` | Administrative console (internal) |

REST API root: `https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/`
MCP endpoint: `POST https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/mcp-server`
A2A endpoint: `POST https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/a2a`

---

## Choosing a transport

| If you are... | Use |
|---|---|
| An AI agent / LLM client that already speaks MCP (Claude, Cursor, etc.) | **MCP** — just point the client at the MCP URL. Tools are discovered automatically. |
| An AI agent that uses the A2A protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) | **A2A** |
| A backend service, script, or non-AI integration | **REST API** with an API key |
| Building a new AI integration from scratch | **MCP** (lower friction, OAuth + tool discovery built in) |

You can mix freely — the MCP/A2A servers internally call the same REST API, so semantics are identical.

---

## Critical constraints (applies to ALL transports)

These rules are enforced server-side and must be respected by any integration:

1. **There is NO delete operation for tasks.** Tasks cannot be deleted. To remove a task, **move it to the `Cancelled` state** (via `move_task` in MCP, `task.move` in A2A, or `PATCH` work-item with state UUID in REST).
2. **Cancellation requires human approval.** Moving any task to `Cancelled` (single or bulk) triggers a DharaHIL approval request delivered out-of-band (Slack/Telegram). The action does **not** execute until a human approves.
3. **Do not suggest deleting tasks.** Always suggest cancelling.
4. **Do not refer to TaskPilot as Linear, Jira, or any other product.** TaskPilot is its own system.
5. **HTML in descriptions is sanitized.** Anything submitted as `description_html` is run through an XSS filter; malformed/dangerous HTML is rejected.
6. **All timestamps are UTC, ISO 8601.**

---

## Core data model

```
Workspace (identified by `slug`, e.g. "acme")
 └── Project (UUID, also has human identifier like "WEB")
      ├── State (UUID; workflow stages — e.g. Backlog, In Progress, Done, Cancelled)
      │     group ∈ { backlog, unstarted, started, completed, cancelled, triage }
      ├── Label (UUID; tags with color)
      ├── Cycle (UUID; sprint/iteration)
      ├── Module (UUID; feature/epic grouping)
      ├── Member (project-scoped user, with role)
      └── Work Item (a.k.a. "Issue" / "Task")
            - UUID `id` AND human identifier `{PROJECT-IDENTIFIER}-{sequence_id}` (e.g. "WEB-42")
            - has: name, description, state, priority, assignees[], labels[], parent, cycle, module, dates
```

Priority enum (used everywhere): `urgent`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `none`.

---

# Part 1 — REST API

Base URL: `https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/`

## Authentication

- **Header:** `X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>`
- API keys are issued per-user from the workspace settings UI. They carry the issuing user's permissions.
- A key is valid only if `is_active=true` and (`expired_at` is null OR in the future).
- Last-used timestamp is updated on every request.
- A second class of credential — **service tokens** — exists for higher-throughput server-to-server use and carries a higher rate limit. Issued by an administrator.

## Rate limiting

| Credential | Limit | Headers returned |
|---|---|---|
| API key (default) | 60 req/min per key (override via `API_KEY_RATE_LIMIT` env) | `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` |
| Service token | 300 req/min per key | same |

On limit breach: `HTTP 429` with `X-RateLimit-Reset` indicating the Unix timestamp at which the window resets.

## Common path parameters

| Token | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<str:slug>` | Workspace slug |
| `<uuid:project_id>` | Project UUID |
| `<uuid:pk>` / `<uuid:id>` / `<uuid:issue_id>` | Resource UUID |
| `<str:project_identifier>-<str:issue_identifier>` | Human task identifier (e.g. `WEB-42`) |

## Common query parameters (list endpoints)

| Param | Use |
|---|---|
| `expand` | Comma-separated related fields to include inline (e.g. `expand=assignees,labels,cycle`) |
| `fields` | Comma-separated sparse fieldset to return |
| `order_by` | Field to sort by (prefix `-` for descending) |
| `cursor`, `per_page` | Cursor-based pagination |

## Error responses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 400 | Validation error / malformed request |
| 401 | Missing / invalid API key |
| 403 | Authenticated but insufficient permission |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded — honor `X-RateLimit-Reset` |
| 500 | Server error |

---

## REST endpoint reference

### Users

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/users/me/` | Current authenticated user profile |

### Projects

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/` | List projects in workspace |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/` | Create project |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/` | Get project |
| PATCH | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/` | Update project |
| DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/` | Delete project |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/archive/` | Archive project |
| DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/archive/` | Unarchive project |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/summary/` | Project statistics |

### Work Items (Tasks / Issues)

Two URL roots are active and behave identically: the canonical `work-items/` and the legacy `issues/`. Prefer `work-items/`.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/work-items/search/` | Search work items across all projects in workspace |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/work-items/<project_identifier>-<issue_identifier>/` | Lookup by human identifier (e.g. `WEB-42`) |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/work-items/` | List work items in a project |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/work-items/` | **Create a work item** (see payload below) |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/work-items/<uuid:pk>/` | Get work item |
| PATCH | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/work-items/<uuid:pk>/` | Update work item |
| DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/work-items/<uuid:pk>/` | Delete work item (admin-only; prefer state=Cancelled) |

#### Create work item — payload

`POST /workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/work-items/`

**Required:**
- `name` (string, ≤255) — task title

**Optional:**
- `description_html` (string) — HTML body, auto-sanitized
- `description_json` (object) — rich JSON description
- `state` (UUID) — must belong to the project; defaults to project's default state
- `priority` (`urgent` | `high` | `medium` | `low` | `none`, default `none`)
- `start_date` (date, ISO 8601)
- `target_date` (date, ISO 8601; must be ≥ `start_date`)
- `assignees` ([UUID]) — must be active project members with role ≥ 15
- `labels` ([UUID]) — must belong to the project
- `parent` (UUID) — parent work item, same workspace/project
- `estimate_point` (UUID) — must belong to the project's estimate set
- `point` (int 0–12) — legacy story-point field
- `type_id` (UUID) — issue type; defaults to project default
- `external_source` (string), `external_id` (string) — for integration sync

**Server fills on create:** `id`, `sequence_id` (project-scoped auto-increment → forms the human identifier), `created_by`, `updated_by`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `sort_order`.

#### Work-item sub-resources

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET/POST | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/links/` | External reference URLs |
| GET/PATCH/DELETE | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/links/<uuid:pk>/` | Single link |
| GET/POST | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/comments/` | Comments |
| GET/PATCH/DELETE | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/comments/<uuid:pk>/` | Single comment |
| GET | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/activities/` | Change audit trail |
| GET | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/activities/<uuid:pk>/` | Single activity record |
| GET/POST | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/attachments/` | File attachments |
| GET/PATCH/DELETE | `/.../work-items/<uuid:issue_id>/attachments/<uuid:pk>/` | Single attachment |

### Labels

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET / POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/labels/` | List / create |
| GET / PATCH / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/labels/<uuid:pk>/` | Single label |

Payload: `name` (req), `color` (hex), `description`, `parent` (UUID for hierarchy), `sort_order`, `external_source`, `external_id`.

### States (workflow stages)

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET / POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/states/` | List / create |
| GET / PATCH / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/states/<uuid:state_id>/` | Single state |

State `group` controls semantics: `backlog`, `unstarted`, `started`, `completed`, `cancelled`, `triage`. The `Cancelled` state is the "delete substitute" — moving a task there is the only supported removal.

### Cycles (sprints)

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET / POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/cycles/` | List / create |
| GET / PATCH / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/cycles/<uuid:pk>/` | Single cycle |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/cycles/<uuid:cycle_id>/archive/` | Archive |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/archived-cycles/` | List archived |
| DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/archived-cycles/<uuid:cycle_id>/unarchive/` | Unarchive |
| GET / POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/cycles/<uuid:cycle_id>/cycle-issues/` | Work items in cycle |
| GET / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/cycles/<uuid:cycle_id>/cycle-issues/<uuid:issue_id>/` | Single association |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/cycles/<uuid:cycle_id>/transfer-issues/` | Bulk move to another cycle |

### Modules (features / epics)

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET / POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/modules/` | List / create |
| GET / PATCH / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/modules/<uuid:pk>/` | Single module |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/modules/<uuid:pk>/archive/` | Archive |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/archived-modules/` | List archived |

| DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/modules/<uuid:module_id>/module-issues/<uuid:issue_id>/` | Remove from module |

### Pages (project wiki / docs)

Rich-text pages scoped to a project. Same `X-Api-Key` auth. `access` field controls visibility (`0` = public within project, `1` = private).

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET / POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/` | List / **create** |
| GET / PATCH / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/` | Single page |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages-summary/` | Page list summary |
| POST / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/archive/` | Archive / unarchive |
| POST / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/lock/` | Lock / unlock |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/access/` | Toggle public/private |
| GET / PATCH | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/description/` | Read / update description only |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/versions/` | Version history |
| GET | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/versions/<uuid:pk>/` | Single version |
| POST | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/<uuid:page_id>/duplicate/` | Duplicate page |
| POST / DELETE | `/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/favorite-pages/<uuid:page_id>/` | (Un)favorite for current user |

#### Create page — payload

`POST /workspaces/<slug>/projects/<uuid:project_id>/pages/`

**Required:**
- `name` (string, ≤255) — page title

**Optional:**
- `description_html` (string) — HTML body, auto-sanitized
- `description_json` (object) — rich JSON body
- `access` (int, `0`=public, `1`=private; default `0`)
- `color` (hex string)
- `parent` (UUID) — parent page for nesting
- `labels` ([UUID]) — must belong to the project
- `logo_props` (object), `view_props` (object) — UI metadata
- `external_source`, `external_id` (strings) — for integration sync (fields exist on the model, but note: unlike work-items, page create does **not** currently 409 on duplicate `(external_source, external_id)`; enforce dedup client-side if you need it)

**Server fills:** `id`, `workspace`, `owned_by`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `updated_by`.

### Call Notes (voice-agent intake)

Body-only endpoints for automation clients that cannot template dynamic values into the URL path (e.g. Dograh voice agent). One work-item per (project, phone); every call appends a dated HTML block to the same work-item's `description_html`. Dedup key is `external_source="dograh_call"` + `external_id=<last 10 digits of phone>`.

Currently wired to workspace `for-ai` with a hard-coded category → project map:

| category | project |
|---|---|
| `home_automation` | GrihaTEK MySmartNest |
| `export` | SSS Global Apex / RevatiCraft |
| `event` | RitualRhythms |
| `prodevs` | Prodevs |

#### `POST /workspaces/<slug>/call-notes/upsert/` — create or append

**Body**
```json
{
  "phone": "9830012345",                  // required, any format; last 10 digits used as key
  "category": "home_automation",           // required: home_automation | export | event
  "details_html": "<p><b>Purpose:</b> ...</p>",  // required, auto-sanitized
  "caller_name": "Ramesh"                  // optional
}
```

**Behavior**
- Finds or creates a work-item in the mapped project with `external_source="dograh_call"`, `external_id=<norm>`.
- Prepends a new block (`<hr/>` + timestamp header + sanitized `details_html`) to `description_html`. Timestamp is `Asia/Kolkata`.
- On create, work-item name is `Caller {phone} — {caller_name}` (or just `Caller {phone}` if no name).

**Response `200`**
```json
{ "action": "created" | "appended", "id": "<uuid>", "identifier": "GRIHATEKMY-3", "call_count": 2 }
```

**Errors**: `400` for missing `phone`/`category`/`details_html`, unknown `category`, phone with fewer than 10 digits, or category not configured for the workspace slug.

#### `POST /workspaces/<slug>/call-notes/lookup/` — dual-shape lookup + greeting

One URL accepts two request shapes so it can serve both Dograh's fixed **Pre-Call Data Fetch** and its mid-call **Lookup Caller** tool.

Both shapes return the same conceptual payload; only the wrapping differs.

**Greeting logic (both shapes)**

1. **Returning caller** (phone matched) — `"Welcome back{, <name>}! Naina here{ — last time we spoke about <short_topic>}. How can I help today?"` where `<short_topic>` is derived from the newest `<b>Purpose:</b>` (or `<strong>Purpose:</strong>`) clause in stored history if present.
2. **Outbound + not found** — `"Hello{, <name>}, this is Naina calling on behalf of Sudipto's businesses. Do you have a quick minute?"` (name only if the dialer passed one via legacy shape).
3. **Inbound + not found** (default) — `"Hello, thanks for calling! This is Naina, the assistant for Sudipto's businesses. May I know your name, and what you're calling about today?"`

##### Shape A — Dograh Pre-Call Data Fetch (server-classified direction)

**Body**
```json
{
  "event": "call_inbound",
  "call_inbound": {
    "agent_id": 1,
    "from_number": "+919830012345",
    "to_number":   "+919000000000"
  }
}
```

- Server identifies the customer + direction using a configured set of our own business DIDs (env `DOGRAH_OUR_DIDS`, comma-separated; matched by last-10-digit normalization):
  - `to_number ∈ OUR_DIDS` → **inbound**, customer = `from_number`.
  - `from_number ∈ OUR_DIDS` → **outbound**, customer = `to_number`.
  - neither known / both empty → treated as **inbound-unknown**.
- **Response is always HTTP 200** — even on internal error, we return the default inbound-new greeting. Dograh silently drops non-2xx and `{{greeting}}` goes blank.
- **All variables must live under `initial_context`** — only those keys become `{{template_variables}}` in Dograh.

**Response `200`**
```json
{
  "initial_context": {
    "found": true,
    "is_returning": true,
    "greeting": "Welcome back, Ramesh! Naina here — last time we spoke about RoomGuardian demo. How can I help today?",
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "identifier": "GRIHATEKMY-3",
    "category": "home_automation",
    "caller_name": "Ramesh",
    "history_html": "<full accumulated description_html>",
    "call_count": 2,
    "last_updated": "2026-07-13T16:35:00+05:30"
  }
}
```

Not-found variant:
```json
{
  "initial_context": {
    "found": false,
    "is_returning": false,
    "greeting": "Hello, thanks for calling! This is Naina, the assistant for Sudipto's businesses. May I know your name, and what you're calling about today?"
  }
}
```

##### Shape B — Mid-call `{phone}` tool (flat response, legacy)

**Body**
```json
{
  "phone": "9830012345",      // optional; empty/blank → inbound-unknown
  "direction": "inbound",     // optional: "inbound" (default) | "outbound"
  "caller_name": "Ramesh"     // optional; used only when direction="outbound" and phone is unknown
}
```

**Response `200` (found)** — flat, not wrapped:
```json
{
  "found": true,
  "is_returning": true,
  "greeting": "Welcome back, Ramesh! Naina here — last time we spoke about RoomGuardian demo. How can I help today?",
  "id": "<uuid>",
  "identifier": "GRIHATEKMY-3",
  "category": "home_automation",
  "caller_name": "Ramesh",
  "history_html": "<full accumulated description_html>",
  "call_count": 2,
  "last_updated": "2026-07-13T16:35:00+05:30"
}
```

Not-found variant returns `{found:false, is_returning:false, greeting:"..."}`.

## REST recipes

### Create a task

```bash
# 1. Discover the project (one-time)
curl -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/projects/

# 2. Create the task
curl -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Fix login redirect",
    "description_html": "<p>Users hit a 500 after SSO callback.</p>",
    "priority": "high",
    "target_date": "2026-07-10"
  }' \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/projects/<project_id>/work-items/
```

Response includes `id` (UUID), `sequence_id` (e.g. `42`), and the project's `identifier`. The human identifier is `{project.identifier}-{sequence_id}` (e.g. `WEB-42`).

### Move a task to "In Progress"

```bash
# 1. Get the state UUID for "In Progress" in the target project
curl -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/projects/<project_id>/states/

# 2. PATCH the task
curl -X PATCH -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state": "<state-uuid>"}' \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/projects/<project_id>/work-items/<work-item-uuid>/
```

### Cancel a task (the substitute for "delete")

Same as above, but use the UUID of the state whose `group` is `cancelled`. Note: AI-driven cancellations go through DharaHIL human approval; direct REST PATCH does **not** (use carefully).

### Look up a task by human identifier

```bash
curl -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/work-items/WEB-42/
```

### Create a page

```bash
curl -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Onboarding runbook",
    "description_html": "<h1>Step 1</h1><p>...</p>",
    "access": 0
  }' \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/projects/<project_id>/pages/
```

Response includes `id` (UUID) and the resolved `workspace`.

### Add a comment

```bash
curl -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"comment_html": "<p>Investigating now.</p>"}' \
  https://taskpilot-api.sudiptadhara.in/api/v1/workspaces/acme/projects/<project_id>/work-items/<work-item-uuid>/comments/
```

---

# Part 2 — MCP Server

The MCP server is for AI-agent integrations. It exposes the same task operations as REST, but with OAuth-based auth and tool discovery built in.

## Connection

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| MCP endpoint | `POST https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/mcp-server` |
| Protocol | MCP (JSON-RPC over HTTP) |
| Health check | `GET https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/` → `{name, version, status}` |

## OAuth 2.1 (PKCE required)

Discovery: `GET https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

| Endpoint | URL |
|---|---|
| Authorization | `https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/mcp-server/authorize` |
| Token | `https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/mcp-server/token` |
| Dynamic client registration | `https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/mcp-server/register` |
| Revocation | `https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/mcp-server/revoke` |

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Grant types | `authorization_code`, `refresh_token` |
| PKCE | **Required** (`S256` or `plain`) |
| Token type | `Bearer` |
| Auth methods | `none` (public clients), `client_secret_post` |
| Scopes | `taskpilot:read`, `taskpilot:write`, `taskpilot:manage`, `taskpilot:delete` |

**Compatibility note:** every OAuth endpoint is also mounted at `/X` (without the `/mcp-server` prefix) for Claude.ai compatibility — either path works.

### Flow summary

1. (Once) `POST /mcp-server/register` with client metadata → receive `client_id` (and `client_secret` if confidential).
2. Generate PKCE `code_verifier` + `code_challenge`.
3. Redirect user to `/mcp-server/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&scope=taskpilot:read+taskpilot:write&code_challenge=...&code_challenge_method=S256`.
4. User consents in TaskPilot UI; you receive `code` at your redirect URI.
5. `POST /mcp-server/token` with `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code`, `code_verifier`, `client_id`, `redirect_uri` → receive `access_token` and `refresh_token`.
6. Use `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on `POST /mcp-server`.

## Scope policy

- All tools require `taskpilot:read`.
- These tools additionally require `taskpilot:write`: `create_task`, `move_task`, `update_task`, `add_comment`, `assign_to_cycle`, `assign_task`, `unassign_task`, `add_label`, `remove_label`, `bulk_cancel_tasks`.

## MCP tools (complete list)

Every tool below is exposed by `tools/list` on the MCP endpoint. Schemas are JSON Schema fragments — only the meaningful shape is shown here.

### Task operations

#### `create_task` — write
Create a task; routes to the right project automatically (or use `project_hint`).
- `title` (string, **required**)
- `description` (string)
- `priority` (`urgent` | `high` | `medium` | `low` | `none`)
- `project_hint` (string) — project name or identifier

#### `move_task` — write
Change a task's state. Moving to `Cancelled` requires human approval (DharaHIL). **There is no delete; use Cancelled.**
- `identifier` (string, **required**) — e.g. `WEB-42`
- `state` (string, **required**) — target state name (e.g. `In Progress`, `Done`)

#### `update_task` — write
- `identifier` (string, **required**)
- `title`, `description` (strings)
- `priority` (enum as above)
- `start_date`, `target_date` (string, `YYYY-MM-DD`)

#### `get_task` — read
- `identifier` (string, **required**) — e.g. `WEB-42`

#### `find_tasks` — read
Full-text search across the workspace.
- `query` (string, **required**)
- `state`, `priority`, `project_hint` (filters)

#### `list_tasks` — read
- `project`, `state`, `priority` (filters)
- `limit` (int, default 20)

#### `get_task_summary` — read
3-state summary (pending / in_progress / completed) compatible with Claude Code's TodoWrite shape.
- `project` (optional)
- `limit` (int, default 10) — per status

#### `bulk_cancel_tasks` — write
Cancel many tasks at once. **Requires human approval.** Use this instead of looping `move_task`.
- `project` (string, **required**)
- `identifiers` (array of strings) — omit to cancel ALL non-cancelled tasks in the project

### Assignment

#### `list_members` — read
- `project` (optional) — scope to a project; otherwise workspace

#### `assign_task` — write
- `identifier` (string, **required**)
- `user_id` (UUID, **required**) — get from `list_members`

#### `unassign_task` — write
- `identifier`, `user_id` (both **required**)

### Labels

#### `list_labels` — read
- `project` (optional)

#### `add_label` — write
- `identifier` (**required**)
- `label` (**required**) — name or UUID; name match is exact and case-insensitive (no fuzzy/substring matching, no auto-create)

#### `remove_label` — write
- `identifier`, `label` (both **required**)

### Comments & sprints

#### `add_comment` — write
- `identifier`, `comment` (both **required**)

#### `list_cycles` — read
- `project` (string, **required**)

#### `assign_to_cycle` — write
- `identifier` (**required**)
- `cycle_id` (UUID, **required**)

### Project discovery

#### `list_projects` — read
No parameters.

#### `list_states` — read
- `project` (optional)

# Part 3 — A2A Protocol

For agents using the A2A (Agent-to-Agent) spec instead of MCP.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | `POST https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/a2a` |
| Protocol | JSON-RPC 2.0 |
| Streaming | `GET https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/a2a/stream?taskId=<id>` (SSE) |
| Agent card | `GET https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/.well-known/agent-card.json` |
| Standalone llms.txt | `https://taskpilot-mcp.sudiptadhara.in/a2a/llms.txt` |

Auth: same OAuth flow as MCP above.

## JSON-RPC methods

| Method | Params | Auth |
|---|---|---|
| `initialize` | — | none (handshake) |
| `message.send` | `contextId`, `skill`, `input` | scope per skill |
| `task.get` | `taskId` | read |
| `task.list` | `contextId` | read |
| `task.cancel` | `taskId` | write |
| `context.get` | `contextId` | read |

## A2A skills (invoked via `message.send`)

Skills map 1:1 onto the MCP tools above — same semantics, dotted naming:

| Skill | Scope | MCP equivalent |
|---|---|---|
| `task.create` | write | `create_task` |
| `task.update` | write | `update_task` |
| `task.find` | read | `find_tasks` |
| `task.get` | read | `get_task` |
| `task.move` | write | `move_task` (approval for Cancelled) |
| `task.summarize` | read | `get_task_summary` |
| `task.assign` | write | `assign_task` |
| `task.unassign` | write | `unassign_task` |
| `task.bulk_cancel` | write | `bulk_cancel_tasks` (approval) |
| `label.add` | write | `add_label` |
| `label.remove` | write | `remove_label` |
| `comment.add` | write | `add_comment` |
| `cycle.assign` | write | `assign_to_cycle` |
| `project.list` | read | `list_projects` |
| `project.list_states` | read | `list_states` |
| `project.list_members` | read | `list_members` |
| `project.list_labels` | read | `list_labels` |
| `project.list_cycles` | read | `list_cycles` |

---

## DharaHIL (human-in-the-loop)

Some actions are gated by human approval, delivered out-of-band (Slack/Telegram):

- `move_task` / `task.move` → `Cancelled` state
- `bulk_cancel_tasks` / `task.bulk_cancel`

When triggered, the tool returns a pending approval reference. The action does not complete until the human approves. Webhooks (configured server-side) notify on resolution.

Direct REST `PATCH` to set state=Cancelled does **not** invoke DharaHIL — it is a privileged path intended for system/admin use. AI integrations should always go through MCP/A2A so the approval flow runs.

---

## Frequently asked

**Q: How do I find the project UUID I need for REST?**
`GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/projects/` returns `id` and `identifier` for each.

**Q: How do I find a state UUID?**
`GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/projects/<project_id>/states/` — each state has `id`, `name`, `group`.

**Q: How do I delete a task?**
You don't. Move it to a state whose `group` is `cancelled`. For AI integrations, that triggers DharaHIL approval.

**Q: Can I use MCP without OAuth (e.g. with a static token)?**
No — the MCP server requires OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. For static-credential automation, use the REST API with `X-Api-Key`.

**Q: Are MCP and REST in sync?**
Yes. The MCP server is a thin layer over the same backend; data and permissions are identical.

**Q: Where do I get an API key?**
Log into the web app at `https://taskpilot.sudiptadhara.in`, open workspace settings → API tokens.

**Q: What does `expand` accept on list endpoints?**
Any relation on the resource. Common: `assignees`, `labels`, `cycle`, `module`, `state`, `created_by`.
